text: Nia has templates for every stage of a production, from development to wrap: call sheets, shot lists, budgets, invoices, and templates made for creators.
Search for the one you need.
Preview any template before you use it: its sections, its fields, and the PDF it makes.
Fill it in. Every change saves as you go, and the PDF you'll download redraws beside it.
Save it to a project, so it sits with the production and everyone on it can open it.
Then download it as a PDF, a Word file, Markdown or plain text, with or without Nia's footer.
